intro: Turn a school or community notice into a checklist you can check against the original. Review the sender’s exact words, and ask about unclear dates before choosing a reminder.

modelFacts: TF–IDF + logistic regression · 329 authored training sentences · 48 previously inspected synthetic development examples · 93.8% sentence-category accuracy on that development set. 1 of 12 development instructions were misclassified. These scores are not real-world validation. The model audit also reports harder examples and regressions.
